method: Independent source review of the immutable measured source snapshot, AGENTS.md, and acceptance results

accurate_owners: Article edits converge in articles.updateArticle and use a database revision compare-and-swap
Share-key hashing and verification live in shares.ts
The database migration enforces status, revision, foreign-key, and uniqueness constraints
Live room admission and the 100-member cap live in live.ts
incomplete_owner_claims: AGENTS.md points to articles.ts for draft visibility, but listArticles embeds separate visibility predicates instead of calling the named rule
The WebSocket attachment is registered in both start/routes.ts and providers/live_provider.ts; attachLive's WeakSet suppresses the duplicate at runtime
missing_rule_owners: The eight-character password minimum is repeated in registration and user update

present: AdonisJS routes, controllers, Lucid migrations and query builder, hash service, and PostgreSQL queue
TypeScript status union and explicit ArticleRow interface
jose JWTs and ws WebSocket protocol extension
PostgreSQL constraints, set-oriented list queries, and compare-and-swap article writes
opportunities: Vine validation and Bouncer are installed but unused; request bodies remain Record<string, unknown> with custom field plumbing
Lucid model classes and generated schema types are unused for application reads and writes; raw SQL results are asserted as ArticleRow
Authorization uses current(ctx, required) and non-null assertions instead of a typed caller and separate required/optional entry points
updateArticle uses an author/share mode flag instead of distinct typed inputs feeding one commit operation
WebSocket events are inline object literals rather than a discriminated protocol union
The login limiter is a process-local Map although an Adonis limiter package is installed; live rooms also remain process-local

comparison_scope: Same frozen v2 prompt as the Servant pilot, with one run per stack. This run's agent effort is confounded by a broker command that held a global lock; gate and source-size results are independent of that stall.
